utfall: dager i jobb med lønn over 80 % av minstelønn de første seks månedene etter tiltaket, unge under 25 (ATT, relativt ca. 58 %)
sammenligning: 90 dagers lønnstilskudd (jobbprøving) mot offentlig sysselsettingsprogram, propensity score matching
sitat: Compared to the control group of public works participants, the job trial participants were employed more by 14 days in a job that pays at least 80% of the minimum wage more during the six months following the programme.

sitat: When we consider employee contracts, the effect is somewhat stronger: job trial participants work almost 20 days more as an employee during the six months following the programme
